section.catchline: Record of delinquent taxes -- Contents of record.
section.subsection: The treasurer shall prepare the official record of delinquent taxes and tax notice charges in the same order as property appears on the assessment rolls.
The record shall also provide space for entering delinquent taxes assessed and tax notice charges listed in subsequent years against each parcel which remains unredeemed.
Taxes levied only on a certain kind or class of property for a special purpose and tax notice charges shall be separately set out.
